title: fix(example-crm): the opportunity dataset's amount measures inherit the tenant currency
body:
Fixes #27158
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 删掉 CRM 示例 `opportunity.dataset.ts` 两个金额度量（`total_amount`、`avg_amount`）上的 `currency: 'USD'`，并把 `pipeline.dashboard.ts` 里引用这个键的注释改成币种的实际来源；并去掉看板两个金额标题里写死的 ($)。
- **为什么改：** `amount` 是动态币种字段，写死 USD 会让非美元组织在管道看板上看到 `$`；去掉后度量走「字段 → 组织默认币种」链（ADR-0104 D1，裁决 6464202770 的 G4）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只动示例元数据与一段注释，无产品代码、无契约改动；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `examples/app-crm/src/datasets/opportunity.dataset.ts`（两行度量）；`examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/pipeline.dashboard.ts`（注释）。
- **两分钟验证：** `git grep -n "currency: 'USD'" -- examples/app-crm` 预期零命中；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm test` 预期 46/46 通过。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `examples/app-crm/src/datasets/opportunity.dataset.ts`: the `total_amount` and `avg_amount` measures over `crm_opportunity.amount` lose `currency: 'USD'`. They now inherit the analytics chain `packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts:3127`, measure `currency` then the field's `defaultCurrency` (fixed mode only) then the tenant default `ctx.currency`. `amount` is a dynamic `Field.currency` with no `currencyConfig`, so the tiles show the tenant default currency. A three-line comment above `measures` says why the key is absent.
- `examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/pipeline.dashboard.ts`: the KPI-tile comment said the measures "declare `format` + `currency`". It now says they declare `format`, and that their currency is the `amount` field's (the tenant default). Comment only.
- No product code, no spec, no docs edit. `examples/app-crm` is `private: true`, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- `pipeline.dashboard.ts`: the `total_pipeline` and `pipeline_by_industry` titles drop their hard-coded `($)` (`'Total Pipeline'`, `'Open Pipeline by Stage'`); the tiles' number face carries the tenant's symbol. Same family, fixed in place on the seat's patch round (addendum 6467121533).

### Q3: confirming the claim's premise (no docs edit)

Both sentences the card named already read as shipped on `main` (`2f96d874`, and unchanged at the merged head `031ff70c`):

- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/index.mdx:121`: "Money, in the field's fixed currency or the tenant default", example "`1000` (a bare number)".
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx:30`: "Store a bare number, no per-record currency code". The section at L290 agrees ("stored as a bare number. The currency is field configuration, never stored per value").

Neither "exchange rates" nor "amount + currency code" survives on either page. That half of the card shipped earlier, so this PR only does G4.

## Tests

At head `8f724ac7` (the title patch): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm test` 6/6 files, 46/46 tests; typecheck exit 0; `objectstack validate` passed; the 34 derived gates all exit 0 (addendum 6467121533). The readings below are the previous head's.

No CRM test, pin or generated artifact asserts or quotes the removed keys. I checked with `git grep` for `opportunity_metrics`, `OpportunityDataset` and `opportunity.dataset` across the tree, then for currency or USD in every file it hit. The one service-analytics test that expects `currency` `USD` (`measure-column-aggregate.test.ts:144`) uses its own fixture and a tenant context of `USD`, not the CRM dataset. No assertion was changed.

The run on the final head `031ff70c` (after merging `origin/main` `b322b5da`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm test`: Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 46 passed (46).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- `objectstack validate` (CRM): "Validation passed". It reports no diagnostic that names a currency, a dataset or `opportunity_metrics`. The `field-no-consumers` warnings are pre-existing.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0. `packages/spec` moved in the merge, so this re-check was needed.

No ablation: the change is example metadata and a comment, and it changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- **Behaviour change in the example:** a CRM tenant with no default currency set now sees the two amount tiles without a currency symbol. Before, they always showed `$`. This is the ruled Q2 = X outcome: no explicit currency and no tenant default means DISPLAY carries no symbol.
- **Same family, not edited (out of scope):** `content/docs/data-modeling/field-type-decision-tree.mdx:228` says "Money needs currency code and decimal handling". This loosely implies a per-value code.
- **Same family, not edited (out of scope):** `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx` (CurrencyValue section) is generated from the `@deprecated` `CurrencyValueSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:581`). It publishes a `{ value, currency }` shape with no deprecation note. ADR-0104 D1 deletes that schema, and its removal rides the next spec major.

I ran all 34 on head `031ff70c` and each exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "34 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 34 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". On the first pass, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET because some packages were unbuilt. I built `./packages/**` and both then exited 0.

`node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs`: "0 docs name something this change touched".
